`agi.md` defines the bounded substrate through Layer 8. `asi.md` defines the finite recursive-improvement

This spec covers finite repo components only:

- broader environment lanes
- goal stabilization and objective continuity scaffolding
- benchmark synthesis
- verifier synthesis
- skill and tool invention
- retrieval-asset self-improvement scaffolding
- policy and prompt proposal scaffolding

- resource and subsystem orchestration scaffolding

It does not claim that the repo has crossed an ASI threshold. It specifies the code substrate that

The repo already contains:

- closed-loop execution with explicit verification
